source_documents.title: Kenya National Cancer Screening and Early Diagnosis Guidelines - Cervical Cancer

indicators.indicator_name: Women screened by a high-performance test
indicators.definition: 2030 target to achieve 70% of women screened by a high-performance test [Human Papillomavirus (HPV) test].
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women screened by a high-performance test (HPV test).
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with HPV screening test performed during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women in the target population.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women in the target population during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; HIV status; screening method; service delivery level
indicators.notes: Source states the 2030 target as 70% screened by HPV test. Denominator is not explicitly defined in the source and is normalized as women in the target population; this requires human review. No KHIS/DHIS2 ID was provided in the source.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with positive screen test who received treatment
indicators.definition: Programmatic performance measure reflected in KHIS data: proportion of women with a positive screen test who received treatment.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women with a positive screen test who received treatment.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with positive screening result and treatment received during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with a positive screen test.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with positive screening result during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: screening method; HIV status; age group; service delivery level
indicators.notes: The source reports that only 33% of those with a positive screen test received treatment according to KHIS 2024. This is a performance metric derived from narrative; denominator and event-date assignment are normalized and require review. No KHIS/DHIS2 ID was provided.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women screened at least twice in the target age group
indicators.definition: Ultimate objective to screen every woman aged 30-49 years nationwide at least twice (35 and 45 years).
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women aged 30-49 years who have been screened at least twice.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women aged 30-49 years with at least 2 documented cervical cancer screening events)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women aged 30-49 years nationwide.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women aged 30-49 years nationwide during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; screening method; HIV status; geography; service delivery level
indicators.notes: The source states an objective to screen every woman aged 30-49 years at least twice (35 and 45 years). This is not presented as a formal indicator in the source; it is normalized as a coverage metric for DAK purposes.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women screened with HPV as primary screening method
indicators.definition: HPV testing is the recommended primary screening method for women eligible for cervical cancer screening.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women screened using HPV as the primary screening method.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with HPV screening test as primary method during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women eligible for cervical cancer screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women eligible for cervical cancer screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; HIV status; self-collected vs provider-collected sample; service delivery level
indicators.notes: The source strongly recommends HPV as primary screening. This indicator is normalized from guidance and not explicitly named in the source.

indicators.indicator_name: Women screened with VIA when HPV unavailable or loss to follow-up risk is high
indicators.definition: Where HPV testing is not yet available, or loss-to-follow-up is a risk, VIA is an acceptable primary screening method.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women screened using VIA as the primary screening method in settings where HPV is unavailable or loss-to-follow-up risk is high.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with VIA primary screening during the reporting period where HPV unavailable or loss-to-follow-up risk high)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women needing screening in settings where HPV is unavailable or loss-to-follow-up risk is high.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women eligible for screening in settings where HPV unavailable or loss-to-follow-up risk is high during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; HIV status; service delivery level; reason for VIA use
indicators.notes: This is a normalized service-delivery indicator derived from the recommendation that VIA is acceptable when HPV is unavailable or loss-to-follow-up risk is high.

indicators.indicator_name: Women screened with cytology when HPV/VIA not suitable
indicators.definition: Pap smear is recommended as a primary screening method for women not eligible for VIA because of a type 3 transformation zone and HPV screening not accessible, and as a primary test in women between <30 years of age.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women screened using cytology as the primary screening method.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with cytology primary screening during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women for whom cytology is indicated as primary screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women meeting cytology primary screening criteria during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; transformation zone status; HPV availability; HIV status
indicators.notes: The source provides two cytology primary-screening situations. This indicator combines them as a normalized metric; separate operational reporting may be needed.

indicators.indicator_name: HPV-positive women triaged with VIA
indicators.definition: In the HPV test screen-triage-and-treat strategy, women who are HPV-positive undergo VIA as a triage test to determine whether they should be treated.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of HPV-positive women who received VIA triage.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with HPV-positive result and VIA triage performed during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with HPV-positive screening results.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with HPV-positive screening result during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: HIV status; age group; service delivery level; triage result
indicators.data_source_event_date: HPV test date; VIA triage date
indicators.notes: This is a process indicator normalized from the HPV triage algorithm. The source does not provide a formal indicator name.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: HPV-positive women treated or referred after triage
indicators.definition: Women who are HPV-positive and VIA-positive will be treated with ablation if adequate, or referred for excisional treatment or further evaluation; women ineligible for ablative treatment should be referred for excisional treatment or further evaluation.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of HPV-positive women who received treatment or referral after triage according to eligibility.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with HPV-positive result and triage-positive result who were treated with ablation if adequate or referred for excisional treatment/further evaluation during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of HPV-positive women with triage-positive results.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with HPV-positive result and triage-positive result during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: treatment modality; HIV status; age group; referral destination
indicators.data_source_event_date: triage date; treatment date; referral date
indicators.notes: This combines treatment and referral outcomes after triage because the source presents them together in the algorithm.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with suspected cancer referred immediately
indicators.definition: Any suspected cancer case after screening should be immediately referred to a gynecologic oncologist for diagnosis and treatment.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women with suspected cancer referred immediately for diagnosis and treatment.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with suspected cancer and immediate referral to gynecologic oncologist during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with suspected cancer identified after screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with suspected cancer identified after screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: screening method; age group; HIV status; service delivery level
indicators.notes: Immediate referral is normative guidance. The denominator is normalized from the trigger condition and should be reviewed.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women treated for precancerous lesions with 1-year post-treatment follow-up
indicators.definition: Women who have undergone treatment for precancerous lesions should receive post-treatment follow-up screening at one year after treatment.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women treated for precancerous lesions who completed follow-up screening at 1 year.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women treated for precancerous lesions with follow-up screening performed approximately 12 months after treatment)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women treated for precancerous lesions.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women treated for precancerous lesions during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: treatment modality; HIV status; histopathology result; age group
indicators.notes: The source specifies 1-year follow-up after treatment. Event-date assignment uses treatment date as the anchor for the reporting interval.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with negative post-treatment follow-up returned to routine screening
indicators.definition: If the initial follow-up test is negative, continued monitoring with HPV or cytology is recommended as per national screening guidelines; return to regular screening is indicated after negative follow-up in the algorithm.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women with negative post-treatment follow-up who returned to routine screening.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with negative post-treatment follow-up result who returned to routine screening during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with negative post-treatment follow-up results.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with negative post-treatment follow-up result during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: follow-up test type; HIV status; treatment modality
indicators.notes: This is a normalized follow-up outcome indicator. The source does not explicitly define a routine-screening return metric.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with positive post-treatment follow-up re-treated or referred
indicators.definition: If the follow-up test is positive, further evaluation and possible re-treatment may be necessary; suspected cancer requires evaluation, biopsy and referral to an appropriate center.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women with positive post-treatment follow-up who were re-treated or referred for further evaluation.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with positive post-treatment follow-up result who received re-treatment or referral for evaluation/biopsy during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with positive post-treatment follow-up results.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with positive post-treatment follow-up result during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: follow-up test type; treatment modality; HIV status; suspected cancer status
indicators.notes: This indicator combines re-treatment and referral pathways because the source presents them as alternative actions after a positive follow-up test.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women living with HIV screened starting at age 25
indicators.definition: Women living with HIV should start cervical cancer screening at age 25 years, regardless of when they first turned HIV positive.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women living with HIV who were screened starting at age 25 years or later according to the guideline.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(WLHIV screened at age >=25 years during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women living with HIV eligible for screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(WLHIV eligible for screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; ART status; screening method; service delivery level
indicators.notes: The source gives a special-population initiation age. This is normalized as a coverage indicator for WLHIV.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women living with HIV screened with HPV as primary test
indicators.definition: Women living with HIV should have HPV-DNA as the primary screening test.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women living with HIV screened with HPV-DNA as the primary test.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(WLHIV with HPV-DNA primary screening during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women living with HIV eligible for screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(WLHIV eligible for screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; ART status; sample collection mode; service delivery level
indicators.notes: The source states HPV-DNA as the primary test for WLHIV. No KHIS/DHIS2 ID is provided.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with HPV-positive result triaged using genotyping, colposcopy, cytology or VIA
indicators.definition: Women who turn screen positive should be followed up with an appropriate triaging strategy using HPV16/18 genotyping, colposcopy, cytology, or VIA.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of HPV-positive women who received triage using one of the recommended triage methods.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with HPV-positive result and triage performed using genotyping or colposcopy or cytology or VIA during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with HPV-positive screening results.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with HPV-positive screening result during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: triage method; HIV status; age group; service delivery level
indicators.notes: This is a normalized triage indicator for WLHIV and other screen-positive women. The source does not specify a single preferred triage method.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Pregnant women screened in first trimester
indicators.definition: Screening can be done in the first trimester (up to the end of week 12).
indicators.numerator_description: Number of pregnant women screened in the first trimester.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(pregnant women screened at gestational age <=12 weeks during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of pregnant women eligible for screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(pregnant women eligible for screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: gestational age; screening method; HIV status; service delivery level
indicators.notes: The source allows screening in the first trimester only; treatment is not to be performed during pregnancy. This indicator is normalized from that guidance.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with suspicious lesions in pregnancy biopsied
indicators.definition: For suspicious lesions in pregnancy, a biopsy can be done at any trimester by a skilled health care provider.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of pregnant women with suspicious lesions who received biopsy.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(pregnant women with suspicious cervical lesions and biopsy performed during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of pregnant women with suspicious lesions.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(pregnant women with suspicious cervical lesions during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: trimester; biopsy setting; provider cadre
indicators.notes: The source warns heavy bleeding could occur during biopsy in pregnancy; this is not a denominator modifier but should be considered in implementation review.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Post-partum women screened at 6 weeks after delivery
indicators.definition: Cervical cancer screening should resume at 6 weeks after delivery.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of post-partum women screened at or after 6 weeks after delivery according to the guideline.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(post-partum women screened at gestational/postpartum age >=6 weeks during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of post-partum women eligible for screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(post-partum women eligible for screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: postpartum interval; screening method; HIV status
indicators.notes: Normalized from postpartum guidance; the source does not specify a formal indicator.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with total hysterectomy appropriately excluded or surveilled
indicators.definition: Women who have had a total hysterectomy generally do not need cervical cancer screening unless hysterectomy was for cervical cancer or severe pre-cancerous lesion/dysplasia; if so, HPV testing or annual cytologic surveillance may continue.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women with total hysterectomy managed according to indication-specific screening guidance.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with total hysterectomy who were either excluded from screening when appropriate or placed on HPV/annual cytology surveillance when indicated during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with total hysterectomy.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with total hysterectomy during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: hysterectomy indication; surveillance modality; history of CIN/cervical cancer
indicators.notes: This is a normalized management indicator for a special population. The source does not define a formal reporting metric.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with HPV vaccination who continue routine screening
indicators.definition: Women who have received the HPV vaccine should receive routine cervical cancer screening as per the national guidelines.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of HPV-vaccinated women who continue routine cervical cancer screening.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with HPV vaccination history and routine cervical cancer screening during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with HPV vaccination history eligible for screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with HPV vaccination history eligible for screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; vaccination status; screening method
indicators.data_source_event_date: screening test date; vaccination history date
indicators.notes: The source explicitly states vaccinated women should still be screened. This is normalized as a coverage indicator.
indicators.cleanup_notes: Unresolved L1 reference after clinician-validated L1 relinking.

indicators.indicator_name: Postmenopausal women screened until age 65
indicators.definition: Postmenopausal women should continue cervical cancer screening with HPV every five years, or cytology every three years, until age 65.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of postmenopausal women screened according to the recommended interval until age 65.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(postmenopausal women screened with HPV every 5 years or cytology every 3 years before age 65 during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of postmenopausal women eligible for screening.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(postmenopausal women eligible for screening during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: age group; screening method; HIV status
indicators.notes: The source provides interval and stopping criteria. This is normalized as a coverage indicator.

indicators.indicator_name: Women with high-grade lesion or cervical cancer under lifelong screening
indicators.definition: For women with a history of high-grade lesion or cervical cancer, screening will be lifelong and dependent on individual risks and history.
indicators.numerator_description: Number of women with prior high-grade lesion or cervical cancer who remain under lifelong screening surveillance.
indicators.numerator_computation: count(women with history of high-grade lesion or cervical cancer and ongoing screening surveillance during the reporting period)
indicators.denominator_description: Number of women with history of high-grade lesion or cervical cancer.
indicators.denominator_computation: count(women with history of high-grade lesion or cervical cancer during the reporting period)
indicators.disaggregations: history of CIN/cervical cancer; screening method; age group
indicators.notes: Normalized from special-population guidance; no formal indicator name is provided.
